description.value: Chute Lake Lodge is a historic mountain resort perched above the Naramata Bench, situated directly along the Kettle Valley Railway corridor — one of BC's most celebrated multi-day cycling routes. Originally built around 1920 as a logger's bunkhouse and rail water stop, it now offers a range of accommodation from rustic cabins and lodge rooms to yurts and glamping tents. The lodge rents e-bikes and offers cycling distance information to Penticton and Kelowna, making it a natural basecamp for KVR touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan highlands.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for Chute Lake Lodge (OSM records this as 'Chute Lake Resort') provides rich content. The FAQ directly addresses bike storage: 'We provide bike racks and guests are responsible for their bikes. Chute Lake Lodge is not liable or responsible in any way for bikes and bike storage' — rack-only, no secure arrangement, which does not meet the WWC secure storage criterion. The site confirms Wi-Fi in the lodge, an on-site restaurant, e-bike rentals, and the About page explicitly links the property to the converted Kettle Valley Railway trail, establishing strong cycling relevance for touring cyclists.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records this business as 'Chute Lake Resort' but the website consistently and exclusively uses 'Chute Lake Lodge' — including in the domain, page titles, and all content. Name updated to website value.
Bike storage is rack-only with an explicit liability disclaimer; does not meet WWC secure overnight storage criterion.
OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only — contact_confirmed fields set to null accordingly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Chute Lake Lodge sits directly on the Kettle Valley Railway cycling trail and explicitly caters to cycling tourists with bike racks, e-bike rentals, route information, and on-site dining. It is a strong candidate for the WWC directory, though the bike storage criterion will need to be flagged as unmet (racks only).
enrichment_extras.notes: The lodge offers e-bike rentals (confirmed in FAQ), which implies some charging infrastructure exists on-site, but the website does not explicitly offer e-bike charging to guests with their own bikes. Worth a direct inquiry.
